settings_hallucination_protection_desc: Check for speech and filter common false captions.
settings_vad_sensitivity_desc: Sensitive keeps quieter speech; Strict rejects more background noise.
settings_home_rail_session_desc: Show session start, duration, segment count, and word count on the home page rail.
settings_home_rail_audio_desc: Show live audio RMS and inference timing metrics on the home page rail.
settings_home_rail_gate_desc: Show recent segment emission gate evaluations on the home page rail.
settings_bug_report_desc: Send a private report with only the details you approve.
settings_toggle_suppress_blanks_desc: Exclude blank tokens at the start of decoding.
settings_toggle_print_special_desc: Include Whisper’s special markers in its text output.
settings_toggle_print_progress_desc: Write Whisper’s progress updates to the diagnostic log.
settings_toggle_token_timestamps_desc: Include timing information for individual pieces of recognized text.
settings_toggle_single_segment_desc: Return one text segment for each recognition pass.
settings_toggle_split_on_word_desc: Split text at whole words when token timestamps are enabled.
settings_toggle_tdrz_desc: Add a marker when a supported model detects a different speaker.
overlay_intro: Position and size the subtitle box on your stream canvas. The browser source covers the full screen — wherever you put the box here is where the captions render.
overlay_test_text: Here is how your captions will look on stream. Make them your own.
overlay_browser_note: as a fullscreen browser source in OBS.
overlay_position_desc: Coordinates are in stream pixels. Origin is the top-left of your canvas.
overlay_text_desc: How captions sit inside the box.
overlay_background_desc: The pill behind the text. Drag the slider for transparency.
overlay_howto_step1: In OBS, add a Browser source.
overlay_howto_step2: Paste the URL above and set the size to match your scene.
overlay_howto_step3: Captions appear when Scrybe is listening.
about_intro: A toy subtitle program useful for providing subtitles to currently playing audio, or for integrating with OBS to provide subtitles to your stream.
about_discord_intro: Join the Scrybe Discord server for help, updates, and discussion.
home_empty_body: Press Start to begin. To change your microphone, or adjust behavior, open Settings.
runtime_cpu_fallback: CUDA is unavailable. Scrybe is using CPU transcription.
runtime_cpu_fallback_nvidia: CUDA failed to initialize. Scrybe is using CPU transcription.
runtime_vad_degraded: Voice activity detection is unavailable. Scrybe is continuing with phrase filtering only: {reason}
sidebar_navigation_description: Open Live captions, Overlay, Settings, or About.
home_help_rms: Audio input level; zero means no measured signal.
home_help_inference: Latest speech recognition time, in milliseconds.
home_help_vad: Latest speech detection time, in milliseconds.
home_help_vad_skip_rate: Checks that found no speech, as a percentage.
home_help_vad_speech_ratio: Speech in the latest checked audio, as a percentage.
home_help_inference_deviation: Variation in recognition times; higher means less consistent.
home_help_inference_percentiles: 90%, 95%, and 99% of recognition attempts took these times or less.
home_help_gate_decision: Sent, or why it was held back.
home_help_gate_distance: Edits since the last caption; a dash means no comparison.
overlay_move_caption: Move captions. Use arrow keys to adjust; hold Shift for larger steps.
overlay_resize_width: Resize caption width. Use left and right arrow keys.
overlay_layout_help: Drag the captions to position them. Drag either end of the orange line to change their maximum width. Height grows with the text.
overlay_setup_intro: Add Scrybe captions to your scene with a Browser source.
overlay_setup_step1: In OBS, click + in Sources and choose Browser. Give it a name, such as Scrybe Captions.
overlay_setup_step2: Paste this URL into the URL field. Leave Local file unchecked.
overlay_setup_step3: Set Width and Height like the dimensions below, then click OK. You can also right click the scene and select Fit to Screen.
overlay_setup_step4: Keep Scrybe open. Press Start to show live captions, or use Test below to check the overlay.
overlay_setup_draft_dimensions: These dimensions include your unapplied changes. Testing previews them temporarily; Apply saves them.
overlay_test_help: A test temporarily replaces live captions for 60 seconds. Changes you make during the test appear in OBS without being saved.
overlay_troubleshooting_body: If captions are missing, check that Scrybe is open on this computer, the Browser source is visible, and the URL is correct. Try Test, then refresh the Browser source in OBS. If placement looks wrong, match the canvas and Browser source dimensions.
overlay_error_apply_help: Your edits are still here. Try Apply again.
overlay_error_test: Could not update the OBS test.
overlay_error_test_help: Try the test action again. An active test ends automatically after 60 seconds.
overlay_error_copy: Could not copy the OBS URL.
overlay_error_copy_help: Open Set Up OBS and select the URL to copy it manually.
settings_source_desc: Choose a microphone or the audio playing through a computer audio device. System defaults are resolved when captions start.
settings_segment_desc: How much audio Scrybe keeps in each caption segment before starting the next one.
settings_devices_error: Could not load audio sources. Try Refresh.
settings_device_missing: This audio source is unavailable. Reconnect it or choose another source.
settings_model_desc: Choose the model that turns speech into captions.
settings_pending_preset: Pending: {model}. Apply will download it if needed (about {size} MB) and load it.
settings_pending_file: Pending: {file}. Apply will load this model.
settings_custom_desc: Use a whisper.cpp model you already have as a .bin file.
settings_enable_filtering: Turn on background noise filtering to change sensitivity.
settings_timestamps_details: Whisper marks token-level timestamps as experimental. Scrybe enables them by default.
settings_speaker_details: Experimental. Requires a model trained for tinydiarize; the standard presets do not provide that model.
settings_stop_first: Stop captions before applying changes to the audio source or model.
settings_error_pending: Your changes are still pending. Review them and try Apply again, or Discard them.
settings_error_busy: Another settings operation is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
settings_error_device: The selected audio source is unavailable. Refresh the list and choose an available source.
settings_error_value: A setting could not be accepted. Check its value and try again.
settings_error_download: Could not download the model. Check your connection and try again.
settings_error_model: Could not load that model. Choose another model or a valid whisper.cpp .bin file.
settings_error_save: Could not apply settings. Try again; technical details are available below.
settings_file_error: Could not open the model file picker.
settings_copy_error: Could not copy the model path.
settings_preset_tiny: Fastest option, with lower recognition quality.
settings_preset_base: Very fast, with basic recognition quality.
settings_preset_small: A balance of speed and recognition quality.
settings_preset_medium: Higher recognition quality, with slower processing.
settings_preset_turbo_q5: The smaller download of the two Large v3 Turbo options.
settings_preset_turbo_q8: The larger download of the two Large v3 Turbo options.
audio_legacy_device: This saved audio source is no longer supported. Choose a microphone or computer audio device.
audio_service_unavailable: Could not connect to your audio service. Check that PulseAudio or PipeWire with pipewire-pulse is running, then try Refresh.
audio_capture_stopped: Captions stopped because the audio source became unavailable.
audio_capture_recovery: Reconnect the device or choose another source in Settings, then try Start again.
inbound_description: Review each item before it leaves this machine.
inbound_generic_recovery: You can report this problem and review the technical details.
inbound_link_recovery: Check your default browser and try again.
inbound_update_check_help: Check your connection and reopen Scrybe to try again.
inbound_update_install_help: Reopen Scrybe to check for the update again.
inbound_runtime_help: Check your model in Settings, then try Start again.
inbound_username_help: This is only used to follow up about this report.
inbound_message_placeholder: Add any context, expected behavior, or steps you tried.
inbound_system_help: Operating system, CPU architecture, and locale.
inbound_build_help: App version, git commit, and build timestamp.
inbound_log_help: The most recent local app log lines, compressed before sending.
inbound_config_help: App settings with known secrets redacted.
inbound_error_help: The error selected for this report.
inbound_done_help: Thanks. A private Discord thread was created for this report.
inbound_load_failed: Could not load report details. Try again.
home_error_start_timeout: Captions did not start within 5 seconds.
home_error_start_timeout_recovery: Check your audio source in Settings, then try Start again.
home_error_previous_session_recovery: The previous session is still stopping. Try Start again, or restart Scrybe if it continues.
home_error_model_busy_recovery: The transcription model is still busy. Try Start again, or restart Scrybe if it continues.
settings_error_model_busy: Transcription is still busy. Try again, or restart Scrybe if it continues.
